description: This Java test class verifies the functionality and immutability of the EnableConnectionLogsResponse class, which is part of the connectivity command responses in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: EnableConnectionLogsResponseTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the EnableConnectionLogsResponse class, including equality, immutability, JSON serialization, and deserialization.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests the correctness of hashCode and equals methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that instances of EnableConnectionLogsResponse are immutable and that ConnectionId is also immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnectionId
methods.description: Ensures that creating an EnableConnectionLogsResponse with a null ConnectionId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that parsing JSON produces the expected EnableConnectionLogsResponse instance.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method produces the expected JSON representation.
